with open('/tmp/klee/runtime/POSIX/fd.c', 'r') as f:

/* aarch64-specific syscall number definitions for KLEE POSIX runtime */
#if defined(__aarch64__) || defined(__arm64__)
#ifndef __NR_access
#define __NR_access 21  /* faccessat(AT_FDCWD, ...) */
#endif
#ifndef __NR_open
#define __NR_open 56    /* openat(AT_FDCWD, ...) */
#endif
#ifndef __NR_utimes
#define __NR_utimes 88  /* utimensat(AT_FDCWD, ...) */
#endif
#ifndef __NR_futimesat
#define __NR_futimesat 88  /* utimensat(fd, ...) */
#endif
#ifndef __NR_chmod
#define __NR_chmod 53   /* fchmodat(AT_FDCWD, ...) */
#endif
#ifndef __NR_chown
#define __NR_chown 54   /* fchownat(AT_FDCWD, ...) */
#endif
#ifndef __NR_lstat
#define __NR_lstat 6
#endif
#ifndef __NR_lstat64
#define __NR_lstat64 6
#endif
#ifndef __NR_stat
#define __NR_stat 103
#endif
#ifndef __NR_stat64
#define __NR_stat64 103
#endif
#endif

"""

lines.insert(insert_idx, aarch64_defs)

with open('/tmp/klee/runtime/POSIX/fd.c', 'w') as f:

print(f"Inserted aarch64 definitions at line {insert_idx}")
